description.value:
Circuitborn. Normalized BBTTCC ancestry root.

Select one heritage separately when building the character: Exo-Knight, Parallax, Salvage, Synapse.

This root grants the shared Circuitborn core trait package and preserves live UUID compatibility for existing feature items.

“You are not a robot. You are a decision the world keeps making about itself.”

Firmware of Identity. You do not eat, drink, or sleep. You enter maintenance trance when you rest. You have advantage on saving throws against poison and disease, and you are immune to magical sleep.

Attention Resonance. Once per long rest, when a creature you can see is intensely focused on you (ally or enemy; GM adjudicates), you may regain either (a) one spent BBTTCC OP (a category you used this scene) or (b) hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

Informational Matrix Sense. You can feel active networks: radio, signal, ritual, rumor. You have advantage on checks to identify surveillance, hidden speakers, encoded messages, or noospheric “attention traps.”

Glitch-Surge. When you drop to 0 hit points, you can choose to emit a controlled burst of static (no damage, but loud and disorienting) before you fall. In BBTTCC play, this is a perfect excuse for weird consequences.

Heritages: Exo-Knight, Parallax, Salvage, Synapse.
